purpose: Current accepted session-only Art contract and final UI/provider candidate. Original v2 retained byte-exact in the 24 November audit.

questions.query: Does opening or hiding Art restore old conversations or copy previous traffic?
facts: New Workbench game sessions begin with an empty conversation and do not restore historical logs.
The first actual event creates one new root JSONL; Hide/reopen keeps that current session and audit.

questions.query: Can missing or corrupt old Art archives prevent a new session from sending?
facts: Normal Art lifecycle does not read historical archives, so missing old logs do not prevent Send.
The retained linked-archive reader has explicit integrity checks for diagnostics only.

questions.query: Can I cancel full Art JSONL export without overwriting an existing destination?
facts: Stop or Cancel export interrupts bounded work; output is staged until native atomic replacement succeeds.
The normal session export contains the current session audit; logs and image bytes are separate from model context.

questions.query: What keeps the long Art conversation editor responsive and preserves Apply/Cancel?
facts: The dialog scrolls its body while retaining the standard Apply/Cancel footer within parent bounds.
The message list fills in bounded slices, live guard polling uses a revision, and Apply checks the full baseline for stale edits.

questions.query: Do native Undo/Redo and manual drawing depend on restoring a previous Art session?
facts: Native PAINT history remains authoritative independently of Art and no old pending-history journal is imported.
Confirmed native results are appended to the current session when Art is mounted; failure logging does not invent completion.
